⚠️ Risk Indicators

Btc Reflexivity HIGH
Measures how much this token's price mirrors Bitcoin's movements. HIGH means the token lacks independent price action and will dump harder when BTC drops.
Liquidity Risk LOW
Evaluates how easily you can exit a position without major slippage. HIGH means thin order books — large sells will crash the price.
Token Supply Inflation LOW
Measures how fast new tokens enter circulation (vesting, emissions). HIGH means your share gets diluted over time even if price stays flat.
What to watch

Watch these risk signals closely: Btc Reflexivity is HIGH. Multiple HIGH risk indicators together suggest elevated caution. Consider reducing position size or setting tighter stops.

💰 Reward Indicators

Funding Rate Bullish
Perpetual futures funding rate. Bullish means shorts are paying longs, indicating the market expects upward movement.
Trading Range Neutral
Where the price sits relative to its recent range. Neutral means it's mid-range with no clear breakout direction.
What to watch

Reward signals lean bullish (1 bullish vs 0 bearish). This suggests the risk/reward may favor entry, but always cross-reference with smart money flows and your own thesis.
